hypothesis: A bounded yaw input that is opposite to the observed forward gait-phase forecast may reduce the approximately 2 Hz body yaw oscillation.
scope: Only the official walking actor's internal yaw-command slot changes during forward motion. Candidate and reference use the same fixed actor, history, physical target limits and external score. The archived replay checks input sensitivity only.
preflight_rule: Replay saved development observations and compare the unmodified actions to the archive. Verify the new action travels through legal-target projection; do not infer physical yaw response from open-loop replay.
next_physical_gate: Freeze a fresh paired seed, original 20-second seven-command criteria, forward yaw and signed speed, full first episodes, unchanged other commands, no new actual joint or posture violations, and real video before visible execution.
